    Home / accessibility

    Legal

    Accessibility, in plain words.

    This is a demonstration site. Nothing here collects, stores or sells anything.

    What this page is

    Folio is a fictional template built to demonstrate design and front-end craft. The forms validate in the browser and stop there — no request leaves the page, and no data is stored.

    What we test

    Every template in this family is checked for WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on text and UI, keyboard reachability of every control, visible focus, a single h1 per page, labelled form fields with error text that is announced, and a full reduced-motion twin for every animation.

    Contact

    Questions about this template belong in the contact form.

    Web Academy FOR CREATORS

    A gallery that converts: your work is the hero and the brand is the frame around it. A fictional academy used to demonstrate this template.
